# Code of conduct

## The short version

Be decent to people. Assume good faith. Criticise code, not the person who
wrote it.

## What that means

Expected:

- treat everyone with respect, whatever their experience level;
- accept feedback gracefully, and give it kindly;
- assume someone asking an obvious question is learning, not wasting your time;
- keep disagreement about the work, not the person.

Not acceptable:

- harassment, insults, or personal attacks;
- sexualised language or imagery;
- publishing someone's private information;
- sustained disruption of discussion.

## Scope

Applies in all NimbusCMS repositories, issues, pull requests and discussions,
and anywhere someone is representing the project.

## Enforcement

Report concerns to **dannymatthew@gmail.com**. Reports are handled privately.

Maintainers may edit or remove contributions that violate this document, and
may block accounts for repeated or serious violations. The intent is to keep
the project a place people are willing to contribute to — not to police tone.
